Do you enjoy taking ownership from start to finish? Are you motivated by solving complex customer needs and working across teams and markets? Join Essity and make an impact through great customer service across the Middle East and Africa.
As a Customer Service Specialist MEA, you will manage the customer journey end-to-end, from order registration and coordination through documentation and ongoing customer communication.

Supporting customers across the Middle East and Africa, you will work across two of Essity’s business areas and partner closely with teams including Sales, Demand Planning, logistics and Compliance. This is a broad customer service role where you will have the opportunity to take real ownership, navigate changing requirements and find practical solutions to keep orders and customer needs moving forward.
q: You have completed higher education and bring the structured thinking needed to work confidently with complex customer and order information.
You have solid experience in Customer Service, Order Management or a similar customer-facing role, ideally with responsibility for an end-to-end process rather than one individual step.
You have hands-on experience with SAP; experience with SAP S/4HANA is an advantage. You are also comfortable working with numerical and order-related information.

You are proactive, organized and solution-oriented, with strong communication skills and a genuine sense of ownership. You are comfortable working across teams, managing changing requirements and following complex issues through to resolution.
You communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are welcome but are not required.

Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well-being, provides meaning to everything we do. Join us to improve well-being for people and drive positive change for society and the environment. At Essity, you'll feel valued, empowered to grow, and challenged to achieve business results in a collaborative and open atmosphere.
Innovate for Good | Excel Together | Be You with Us

This position is based in Dubai, UAE, and offers the opportunity to work in an international environment supporting customers across the wider Middle East and Africa region. The role is office-based, with flexibility around office days and working hours.
You'll join a collaborative customer service team and gain exposure to different markets, customer needs and business areas, while working closely with colleagues across multiple functions.
r: Order Management: Manage customer orders end-to-end, from order registration through coordination, follow-up and customer communication.
Customer Support: Act as a trusted point of contact for customers, providing clear updates and resolving order-related questions and issues.
Logistics Coordination: Coordinate loading and delivery requirements with internal logistics teams to support smooth and timely order fulfilment.
Demand Coordination: Work closely with Demand Planning when customer orders differ from forecasts or require additional internal alignment.
Pricing & Documentation: Maintain accurate price lists and prepare complete documentation packages following loading, including customer-specific or regulatory documents where required.
Problem-Solving: Investigate complex or changing customer requirements, identify the right stakeholders and drive issues through to resolution.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build effective relationships across teams and functions, bringing together the right expertise to support customers and continuously improve ways of working.

d: Located in the heart of Place Vendome, the Maison Chaumet is a major actor in the luxury sector and represents the symbol of the Parisian jewellery excellence since its creation in 1780. Thanks to its exceptional knowledge passed from one generation to the other, Chaumet’s history is merged with the French History and that of the Empress Joséphine. Currently in transformation and anchored in modernity, Maison Chaumet is now part of a global repositioning context with strong growth in sales within the LVMH group.
In this dynamic and challenging growth context, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of one of our Chaumet boutiques in Kuwait.
r: Being Ambassador of the Maison to all our clients
Share the passion of more than 240 years of history, with a culture of excellence and knowledge;
Make the Chaumet Experience alive by a warm and luxurious welcoming;
Offer a relevant selection of pieces and assist the client in his purchasing process;
Play a key role in the selling ceremony knowing how to surprise the client;
Take clients on an emotional journey and drive them through the discovery of the world of Chaumet.
Contributing to the boutique’s commercial development by finding new clients and retaining existing ones
Achieve your sales objectives to make sure the boutique and your colleagues achieve theirs;
Actively participate in the development of the customer database by consulting, creating and updating customer files;
Create new future opportunities after concluding sales by developing your own customer portfolio and enlarging our reachable client base;
Carry out clienteling activities by inviting our clients and prospects to events organized by the Maison;
Anticipate VIP Clients visit by preparing the right selection depending on the occasion.
Participating to flawless store operations and being an active part of the store’s life
Contribute to achieve the boutique’s collective targets by working with your colleagues;
Actively participate in team meetings, challenges, events and activities, giving your contribution;
Participate in the reporting and monitoring of performance indicators and customer feedback;
Ensure the application of security guidelines, cashier registration procedures and stock management rules;
Contribute to reporting and analysis as requested by the HQ, be a point of reference for Client’s feedback;
Visual Merchandising: work on windows and internal display in collaboration with the Visual Merchandising team;
